dedupe_keys.name: oscgrid substation voltage and current oscillograms

description: The OscGrid team publishes voltage and current oscillograms recorded at real electrical substations during routine operations and disturbances. The own Figshare description reports 50,765 traces. The Scientific Data descriptor identifies a manually labelled set of 480 events, with noise, routine switching, noncritical deviations and faults, and sampling rates up to eight kilohertz. Archives contain COMTRADE signals and processed CSV versions. Coverage is sampled substations whose locations were anonymized. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The traces can validate transient simulations and test protection-event classifiers or validate fault signatures around a network model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that anonymization and normalization remove some original operating context; a labelled waveform is not a complete network state or fault-location record. Sample-rate differences and trimmed normal sections matter when comparing models. The own deposit metadata and archive listing were checked without downloading oscillograms. The separate conversion and validation code is assessed in another batch.
